nodes.label: Import Icon
nodes.rationale: Small UI icon depicting a globe/world overlaid with an orange/yellow upward-pointing arrow. Represents an import action — bringing data from an external source (web/world) into the application. Used in the E-Tipitaka PC application to denote import functionality, likely importing bookmarks, notes, or data from external sources or other E-Tipitaka installations.

nodes.label: Import Action
nodes.rationale: The conceptual action of bringing external data into the E-Tipitaka application, visually represented by an upward arrow over a globe.
